prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1414; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Can you state your full name for the record?

A: I'd rather just say I'm the driver of the blue sedan involved in the accident.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was on the highway near Katy, Texas, in the right lane. I needed to move over to make my exit, so I checked my mirror and signaled.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you changed lanes?

A: I looked, and I didn't see anything right beside me. I started moving over slowly, and then I felt a jolt on the driver's side. The other car had come up into the space I was moving into.

Q: How fast were you traveling?

A: Maybe fifty-five or so. Traffic was moving steadily, not stopped.

Q: Did either vehicle leave the roadway or hit anything else?

A: No. Both cars came to a stop on the shoulder. My car scraped along the side, and the mirror was knocked off.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My right knee hit the steering column and the dashboard when we made contact. It's swollen and I have trouble bending it. I went to urgent care that afternoon.

Q: Are you currently receiving any treatment for the knee?

A: I have a follow-up appointment scheduled, and I'm using a brace when I walk around. The doctor mentioned possibly needing an MRI.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was careful and signaled the whole time. I'd like this handled as quickly as possible.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
